Plex needs atlas (it runs as a Docker container there) and tank (its library on tank/media and appdata on tank/appdata).

If titan is off, the Ollama endpoint stops (direct, it runs on titan's GPU) and the wiki-search service degrades: new pages are not embedded, though keyword search still works (second hop, via ollama-endpoint).
The nightly rclone backup needs atlas (it runs there), tank (it reads the 05:45 tank snapshot) and gate (for internet access to upload).
The hermes VM needs atlas (it runs as a VM there and stops when atlas stops) and tank (its vdisk is on tank/domains and it cannot boot without tank).

If atlas stops, Syncthing (a container on atlas) stops, so notes stop syncing to pebble. Syncthing to pebble runs only over Tailscale, which itself runs on atlas, so the sync is lost directly via Syncthing and through Tailscale.

Directly, gate going down takes out aria (network features), atlas (Unraid email notifications), rclone-backup (upload), reverse-proxy (outside access on 443) and tailscale (internet access). Second hop: via atlas, hermes, plex, syncthing and tank also stop; via tailscale, pebble and syncthing lose remote access and sync.
